generic_error_description: We couldn't verify your session. Please sign in again or contact your administrator if the problem continues.
token_size_description: The access token exceeds the maximum allowed size (4KB cookie limit) and cannot be processed.
token_size_cause: Root cause: excessive role claims included in the token payload.
step_reduce_roles: Reduce the number of roles assigned to the user
step_reissue_token: Reissue the token after role adjustment
no_permission: You don't have permission to view this application.
geo_no_child_levels: No further child levels under this location
geo_delete_level_confirm: Delete level "{name}"? This removes the level from the hierarchy. Existing administrative units at this level may also be affected.
geo_select_node_hint: Choose a node in the hierarchy to view and manage its administrative units.
geo_no_levels: No levels configured. Add a level to start the hierarchy.
geo_delete_level_value_confirm: Delete "{name}" and all administrative units below it? This cannot be undone.
confirm_remove_attribute_msg: Delete this dataset and all of its entries? This cannot be undone:
confirm_remove_attribute_value_msg: Are you sure you want to remove
attr_hierarchical_hint: Click an entry with child entries to drill down
error_value_code_exists: An entry with this code already exists
error_attribute_code_exists: A dataset with this code already exists
error_geo_level_exists_with_parent: Geo level already exists with this parent
error_geo_value_exists_with_parent_level: Administrative unit already exists with this parent and level
error_duplicate_key: A record with this value already exists
error_cannot_delete_with_dependencies: Cannot delete item with existing dependencies
error_cannot_disable_hierarchical: Cannot disable hierarchical while entries have parent entries
error_cannot_be_own_parent: Item cannot be its own parent
cat_effective_from_hint: Leave empty to take effect when approved. A future date schedules the version.
cat_effective_from_approve_hint: Optional: overrides the draft's effective date. Leave empty to keep it (or publish now).
cat_submit_message: The draft is validated (labels, hierarchy, entry fields against the schema and dataset references) and can no longer be edited while it waits for approval.
cat_approve_message: Publishing makes this version immutable. Consumers reading the latest version get it from its effective date.
cat_discard_message: Discard draft version {no} and all its changes? It is kept as Discarded for the record and its number is not reused. Published versions are not affected.
cat_awaiting_approval: Submitted: waiting for a user with publish permission to approve or reject it.
cat_awaiting_awe: Submitted: approval runs in the Approval Workflow Engine (request {ref}).
cat_maker_cannot_approve: You created, edited or submitted this draft, so another person must approve or reject it.
cat_readonly_view_draft_hint: This version is read-only. Switch to the draft to make changes.
cat_readonly_open_draft_hint: This version is read-only. Open a draft to make changes; they are published after approval.
cat_list_create_hint: The dataset is created with its first draft (version 1). Add entries, then submit the draft for approval to publish it.
cat_list_edit_hint: Description, publisher and theme apply at once. Code, label, labels by language and the hierarchy flag are saved into the dataset's draft and published on approval.
cat_owner_org_hint: Department that publishes the dataset (used for approval routing).
cat_changes_pending_hint: Version {no} is published but not yet in effect (future effective date).
cat_attributes_json_hint: This dataset has no schema; an entry's fields are free JSON (an object).
cat_recode_hint: Changing the code keeps the same entry (a recode); old references still resolve in earlier versions.
cat_retire_value_message: Retire "{name}" in the draft? It stays in earlier versions so existing references still resolve; an entry added in this draft is removed.
cat_schema_help: JSON Schema for the fields of each entry (type object with properties). A field can point at another dataset with x-list-ref set to that dataset's code; the entry form then offers that dataset's entries. Saved into the draft and validated again on submit.
cat_schema_placeholder: Paste or write a JSON Schema, or start from the example.
cat_schema_readonly: Read-only: open the draft to change the schema.
cat_schema_err_not_object: The schema must be a JSON object.
cat_schema_err_top_type: The top-level type must be "object" (it describes the fields of each entry).
cat_schema_err_required: "required" must be an array of field names.
cat_schema_err_required_unknown: "required" names "{name}", which is not a field.
cat_schema_err_ref: {path}: x-list-ref must be a dataset code.
cat_feed_search: Filter by event, subject or user
cat_feed_truncated: Only the first 20,000 events are loaded.
cat_feed_hint: Every lifecycle step of datasets, geography and releases, newest first.
cat_geo_empty: No geography version exists yet. Open a draft to add levels and administrative units, or load a country pack.
cat_levels_readonly_hint: Levels of this version are read-only. Switch to the draft to change them.
cat_level_id_placeholder: Stable id of the level, e.g. region
cat_unit_id_recode_hint: To change a unit's code, add the new unit, retire the old one and record a RECODE event.
cat_parent_unit_hint: P-code of the parent unit (changing it is a REPARENT).
cat_retire_unit_message: Retire "{name}" and its active descendants in the draft? Retired units stay in earlier versions; units added in this draft are removed. Record a change event (e.g. SPLIT or MERGE) to say where it went.
cat_unit_reactivated: Administrative unit reactivated in the draft
cat_change_rule_CREATE: CREATE: the to-units are new units, active in the draft.
cat_change_rule_RETIRE: RETIRE: the from-units were active in the base version and are retired in the draft.
cat_change_rule_RENAME: RENAME: one unit, same code, whose name differs from the base version.
cat_change_rule_RECODE: RECODE: one old code (retired) to one new code (new), on the same level.
cat_change_rule_SPLIT: SPLIT: one from-unit (retired, or kept as one of the parts) to two or more active to-units.
cat_change_rule_MERGE: MERGE: two or more from-units (retired, or the survivor) to one active to-unit.
cat_change_rule_REPARENT: REPARENT: one unit, same code, whose parent differs from the base version.
cat_change_rule_BOUNDARY_CHANGE: BOUNDARY_CHANGE: units active in both versions whose boundary changed.
cat_units_input_hint: P-codes separated by commas or spaces.
cat_effective_date_hint: Defaults to the version's effective date.
cat_auto_hint: Generated at submit for a change not covered by a recorded event.
cat_auto_events_hint: Events for changes you do not record are generated automatically at submit.
cat_boundary_inherited: Unchanged since an earlier version (shared object).
cat_boundary_hint: Boundaries of a published version are immutable. Download a level's GeoJSON.
cat_boundary_draft_hint: Upload a level's GeoJSON FeatureCollection (features keyed by properties.pcode) into the draft. It becomes immutable when the draft is published.
cat_boundary_not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
cat_boundary_not_fc: The file must be a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
cat_crosswalk_hint: Find where a unit of one geography version went in another: its successors going forward (predecessors going backward), following the recorded change events.
cat_releases_hint: A release pins one published version of each chosen dataset plus a geography version, so consumers can pin everything at once.
cat_release_members_incomplete: Choose a dataset and a published version on every row.
cat_release_maker_hint: You created this release or last set its members, so another person must publish it.
cat_theme_hint: Groups datasets for browsing, e.g. core or agriculture (set by the country pack for pack datasets). Applies at once.
home_hint: Datasets by theme, the geography in effect, work waiting for review and recent activity.
